notes.title: Build 1.19 [Technical] - 26.06.2021
notes.content:
Hi, this is my second update released.  Once again I am improving many features and what I broke in the previous update ;)

What's new in this update?
- Now, all updates will have own names in changelog.
- Fix Options Bugs.
- Change guns bullets speed.
- Now, player always spawn front of the shop.
- Change Camera FOV value (Min. 70 > 60 / Max. 90 > 120).
- Repair terrain in "Plaza" map.
- Repair Water in "Plaza" map.
- Now, every 5 complete waves, add 150$ to next wave complete bonus.
- Fix shop and ambient sounds.
- Fix Day/Night button.
- Now, zombies can't go through walls.

Develop Changes
-Remake and upgrade Weapon System.
-Change guns Recoil System.

Thanks for your patience! :D
~GreQu
